items.q: Match the following erythropoiesis stage to its full name — 1) BFU-E  2) CFU  3) The final cell … A) Colony forming unit  B) Burst forming unit-erythroid  C) Erythrocyte (RBC)
items.exp: Erythropoiesis: hematopoietic stem cell → BFU-E (burst forming unit-erythroid) → CFU (colony forming unit) → erythroblast → reticulocyte → erythrocyte (RBC). (Book p808)

items.q: Match the following erythropoiesis phase to its dependency — 1) Hematopoietic stem cell → BFU-E  2) BFU-E → CFU → erythroblast  3) Erythroblast → reticulocyte → RBC … A) Iron and erythropoietin dependent  B) Erythropoietin dependent  C) EPO independent
items.exp: EPO independent: stem cell → BFU-E; erythropoietin dependent: BFU-E → CFU → erythroblast; iron and erythropoietin dependent: erythroblast → reticulocyte → RBC. (Book p808)

items.q: The erythropoietin-dependent span (BFU-E through erythroblast) is labelled as taking:
items.exp: 10-14 days erythropoiesis labels the erythropoietin-dependent span. (Book p808)

items.q: The full sequence of erythropoiesis on the page is:
opts: Stem cell → BFU-E → CFU → erythroblast → reticulocyte → RBC
Stem cell → CFU → BFU-E → reticulocyte → erythroblast → RBC
BFU-E → stem cell → CFU → erythroblast → RBC → reticulocyte
Stem cell → erythroblast → CFU → reticulocyte → BFU-E → RBC
items.exp: Sequence as drawn: hematopoietic stem cell → BFU-E → CFU → erythroblast → reticulocyte → erythrocyte (RBC). (Book p808)

items.q: All but one are named stages in the erythropoiesis diagram. Which is the odd one out?
items.exp: Named stages: hematopoietic stem cell, BFU-E, CFU, erythroblast, reticulocyte, erythrocyte (RBC). (Book p808)
